evals.name: vague-send-no-change-named
evals.prompt: send the spec to my kindle
evals.expected_output: Auto-detects the sole active change, renders reports/add-python-ir-lowering.epub containing all artifacts, reads KINDLE_EMAIL from .env without dumping the file, and prepares (not sends) a Gmail message with an application/epub+zip attachment.

evals.name: proofread-on-ereader
evals.prompt: i want to proofread the ir lowering spec + the design doc on my e-reader tonight, can you get them over there? the openspec change is add-python-ir-lowering
evals.expected_output: Renders the EPUB for add-python-ir-lowering including the ir-lowering spec and design chapters, then prepares the Kindle send.

evals.name: regenerate-after-edit
evals.prompt: I tweaked tasks.md a bit. can you rebuild the epub for add-python-ir-lowering and email it over to my kindle again
evals.expected_output: Re-renders from disk (does not reuse a stale artifact), confirms the tasks chapter is present, prepares the send, and does not overclaim delivery to the device.
